stance_rationale: The package is not optimizer-ready: post-shrink condition number is 193.78 despite the QEPM cond <= 100 mandate, factor coverage R2 is below 30%, and mandatory tail/regime/crowding audits are incomplete. PD is verified, but PD alone does not clear RF-R2, RF-R4, RF-R6, RF-R8, AX-002, or AX-008.

regime_sigma_audit.comment: Only normal/high_vol regime correlation is emitted; no BULL/NORMAL/CAUTION/CRISIS regime-conditional Sigma, bootstrap CI, pooled fallback, or switch-rate audit is provided.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: FAIL: TDC vs PG2 active book and style correlation vs existing active are absent; max hhi_top=0.2153 exceeds the 0.10 recommendation.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Security Sigma lookback ends at sig_date - 1; covariance matrix has min eigenvalue 0.05 and no negative eigenvalues.
Current top-20 liquidity check uses last_sig_date-30 through last_sig_date-1 and emits no liquidity flags; requested weights.csv is still missing.
No external FRED/ECOS macro series was used in the risk package artifacts.
Omega factor returns are built with expo_last/current style scores applied across the 252-day window, not date-wise PIT factor exposures.

critical_concerns.description: Post-shrink Sigma condition number is 193.78, above the mandated cond <= 100; the package silently substitutes target_cond=200 and only flags RF-R2 when cond>500. [RF-R2, AX-002]
Factor coverage median R2 is 0.198 < 0.30, but the package still uses BΩB'+D without the required 100% shrinkage justification for weak coverage. [RF-R2, AX-002]

Stress evidence is not reliable: GFC stress MDD is -50.62% > the 45% hard fail, only 6 historical periods are replayed, and GFC replay has only 35.37% weighted return coverage for the 2023 holdings. [RF-R4, PIT-C6, AX-002]
MKT contributes 64.8% of total portfolio variance, breaching RF-R1; deferring the fix to Optimizer leaves the risk package without usable exposure bounds. [RF-R1, AX-001, L-122]
Factor-return construction for Omega is not PIT-clean because current expo_last style scores are used for the full lookback window rather than historical date-wise exposures. [PIT-C12, AX-002]
Regime risk is reduced to two correlation rows, with high_vol n=37 and no bootstrap CI, pooled fallback, CRISIS Sigma, or switch-rate validation. [RF-R8, PIT-C9, L-454]
Tail audit omits monthly CVaR_95, CDaR_95, Hill alpha, and valid parametric VaR/ES; Cornish-Fisher is null and RF-R6 cannot be cleared. [RF-R6, AX-002]

Crowding diagnostics do not measure TDC or style correlation versus PG2 active; max hhi_top=0.2153 and passive_overlap_proxy=0.6 are not reconciled with L-219 family saturation risk. [RF-R3, RF-R5, L-219]

No risk_challenge_note.md, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, or requested weights.csv exists in the worktask path, so Charter No Silent Override and AX-008 triangulation are incomplete. [AX-008, AX-002]

supporting_arguments: Covariance.parquet is symmetric, PD, min eigenvalue=0.05, and has no negative eigenvalues, so RF-R9 is not triggered.
Stage alpha_scores are time-series artifacts, not single-snapshot: qepm path has 83 dates and PROD path has 116 dates.
weights_schedule.parquet passes basic 20-name, long-only, sum-to-1, max-weight<0.20 checks; annual two-way turnover is 5.3007.
unresolved_disputes: Whether cond<=100 is allowed to be relaxed to target_cond=200; no mandate exception is documented.
Whether current-holding historical stress replay is acceptable when many current holdings did not trade in early stress windows.
Whether weak factor coverage R2 can support optimizer inversion without full shrinkage or a different estimator.
Whether missing risk_challenge_note.md is a draft artifact gap or a No Silent Override violation.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that a PD factor-model Sigma with median R2=0.198 and condition number=193.78 is optimizer-ready merely because eigen-flooring achieved target_cond<200.
rebuttal_required: Rebuild Sigma with post-shrink cond<=100, report shrinkage intensity delta, and show PD/min-eigen diagnostics.
If factor coverage remains below 30%, justify 100% shrinkage or replace the factor model with a better-supported estimator.
Recompute Omega with date-wise PIT factor returns, not current expo_last scores over the whole lookback.
Provide monthly CVaR_95, CDaR_95, Hill alpha, parametric plus EVT VaR/ES, and all 8 required stress periods with coverage diagnostics.
Add TDC/style correlation versus PG2 active book and family saturation checks.
Create risk_challenge_note.md and provide the requested weights.csv or a signed replacement mapping to weights_schedule.parquet.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Independent artifact checks show PD is real, but hard risk gates fail or are unverified: cond<=100, factor coverage, tail risk, regime Sigma, PG2 crowding, and No Silent Override.

risk_specific_questions: Why is target_cond=200 acceptable when the role prompt and user mandate require cond<=100 post-shrink?
How is Optimizer expected to use this Sigma when factor coverage median R2 is only 19.8%?
Are GFC/COVID stress replays valid after setting missing returns for non-listed 2023 holdings to zero?
What is the exact TDC/style-correlation definition versus PG2 active book?
